chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Jaʿfar ibn Bashīr, from some of his men, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the blood money for a child born of zina, and he said: “Eight hundred dirhams, like the blood money of a Jew, a Christian, and a Magian.”

key_terms.النَّصْرَانِيِّ: a Christian, mentioned here for legal comparison in diyah
key_terms.الْمَجُوسِيِّ: a Magian, mentioned here for legal comparison in diyah
key_terms.الْيَهُودِيِّ: a Jew, mentioned here for legal comparison in diyah
key_terms.ثَمَانُمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ: eight hundred dirhams, the stated legal amount
key_terms.دِيَةِ: blood money or financial compensation due for unlawful killing or injury

ai.seo_question: What is the diyah for a child born of zina according to this hadith from Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the diyah of a child born of zina. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that it is eight hundred dirhams, equating it with the diyah assigned here to a Jew, Christian, and Magian.
